title: DART Recap Video
description: Since NASA’s Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) successfully impacted its target on Sept. 26, 2022  – altering the orbit of the asteroid moonlet Dimorphos by a whopping 33 minutes – the DART team has determined that the mission's kinetic impactor technique can be an effective way to change the trajectory of an asteroid.   These findings were published in four papers in the journal Nature on March 1, 2023. Learn more: https://go.nasa.gov/3ZcTOae
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
